title: Switches
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about counters that do more than count keys. A lever flips when you walk into it and puts planks on a counter, and the dotted planks over a pool spend one each as you step on them and turn solid. A red lever pays for red planks and a blue lever for blue. Signs say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change what a lever gives.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie has two short levels to cross, and a pool in the way each time. A lever on the path fills a counter, and the dotted planks over the water spend it one by one and turn solid. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and change what a lever gives.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
A lever fills a counter and dotted planks spend it, one each
Made to be copied and taken apart
